synthesis.paragraph: In the urban data science literature, "Deciphering Mobility in “Strip Cities”" shares 3 references with the June 16 paper "Identifying subnetworks and driving factors of intercity mobility in mega-urban agglomeration areas," including "Finding and evaluating community structure in networks," "The universal visitation law of human mobility," and "Emergence of urban growth patterns from human mobility behavior." Additionally, "Spatial Association of Public Electric Vehicle Charging Stations and Urban Public Facilities" shares 3 references with the June 22 paper "Spatial heterogeneity in factors influencing utilization rate of electric vehicle charging stations," specifically "Spatial equity analysis of urban public services for electric vehicle charging," "Influence of charging stations accessibility on charging stations utilization," and "EV charging habits and their impact on public charging infrastructure usage." Finally, "Understanding Passenger Acceptance of Autonomous Buses" shares 3 references with the June 14 paper "Bridging the digital divide in urban mobility," which are "Perceived Usefulness, Perceived Ease of Use, and User Acceptance of Information Technology," "User Acceptance of Information Technology: Toward A Unified View1," and "What influences the decision to use automated public transport?." Over the last 30 days, Hong Kong Polytechnic University has appeared on 14 papers, the University of Hong Kong on 13, and both Tsinghua University and Peking University on 12.
